nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Excludes files and directories (node_modules, dist, local env files, etc.) from the Docker build context for the frontend image.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Docker build for the frontend Vite/React app: installs dependencies, copies source, creates a non-root user, exposes port 3000, and runs the Vite dev server bound to all interfaces.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-stage build tailored for development (runs `npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000`) rather than a production static build.
